messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that falls on a weekday and is adjacent to a weekend (Saturday / Sunday). When the holiday itself is on a weekend, the *observed* day (if any) is used to create the long weekend.

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Observed (if applicable) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---|---------|-------------|-------------|--------------------------|-------------------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sun) | Sun | Jan 2 (Mon) | **Jan 1–3** (Sun–Tue) |
| 2 | Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB, ON) | Feb 20 (Mon) | Mon | – | **Feb 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| 3 | Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | Fri | – | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) |
| 4 | Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | Mon | – | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) |
| 5 | Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) | Sat | – | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) |
| 6 | Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | Mon | – | **Sep 2–4** (Sat–Mon) |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Thu) | Thu | – | **Oct 9–11** (Thu–Sat) |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Fri) | Fri | – | **Nov 9–11** (Sat–Mon) |
| 9 | Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Mon) | Mon | – | **Dec 23–25** (Sat–Mon) |

### Notes & Quick Tips

| Item | Detail |
|------|--------|
| **Observed Days** | Only New Year’s Day has an observed day in 2023 because it fell on a Sunday. All other holidays fell on weekdays. |
| **Regional Variations** | Family Day is observed in several provinces (BC, AB, SK, NB, ON). Other holidays are nationwide. |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tue) is a holiday but does not create a long weekend because it is not adjacent to a weekend. |
| **Planning** | If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, you can use the “Long‑Weekend Span” column to highlight dates that give users extra days off. |

Feel free to copy this table into your app’s data store or use it as a reference for generating calendar events. If you need the same information for other years or additional details (e.g., province‑specific holidays), let me know!
